_comment: Starting contexts per race per location. Each context gives a reason to be there, sets flags, and seeds different story openings.

Ironreach Outpost.label: Garrison Soldier
Ironreach Outpost.description: You're posted here as part of the Ironclad Dominion's border guard. The work is dull, the pay is late, and something in the ruins has been making the sentries uneasy.
Ironreach Outpost.backstory: Three years in the Dominion's service brought you to Ironreach — the posting nobody asks for twice.

Ironreach Outpost.label: Adventurers Guild Investigator
Ironreach Outpost.description: The Guild sent you to look into a series of missing supply caravans. You've only been here two days and already you don't like what you're not being told.
Ironreach Outpost.backstory: The Guild's coin spends the same anywhere. What keeps you at Ironreach is a contract you can't quite close.

Ironreach Outpost.label: Local Trader
Ironreach Outpost.description: You run a modest stall at the outpost market. You know everyone, everyone owes you something, and you've learned that 'quiet' here is never a good sign.
Ironreach Outpost.backstory: Commerce is just organised listening. You've been listening to Ironreach for years.

Ironreach Outpost.label: Wandering Exile
Ironreach Outpost.description: You ended up here because here was far enough from somewhere else. The outpost doesn't ask questions. An uneasy arrangement, until tonight.
Ironreach Outpost.backstory: The road brought you here. You haven't decided if it's a destination or a waypoint.

Sunshade Market.label: Established Merchant
Sunshade Market.description: You've held a stall at Sunshade for two years. Business is good, the competition is fierce, and someone has been skimming from the Guild's ledgers.
Sunshade Market.backstory: You built something here from nothing. Protecting it is just good sense.

Sunshade Market.label: Merchant Guild Enforcer
Sunshade Market.description: The Guild pays you to make sure debts get settled and rules get followed. It's not glamorous, it pays well, and you're very good at it.
Sunshade Market.backstory: You've never had to hurt anyone who didn't have it coming. That record is getting harder to maintain.

Sunshade Market.label: Travelling Scholar
Sunshade Market.description: You stopped at Sunshade to resupply and stayed three weeks chasing a lead buried in an old transaction record. The lead keeps growing legs.
Sunshade Market.backstory: Truth hides in receipts and registers. Sunshade has excellent archives for a market.

Sunshade Market.label: Runaway Noble
Sunshade Market.description: You've had to be very ordinary, very deliberately, for the past four months. Sunshade is good for that. Nobody cares who your family is.
Sunshade Market.backstory: Anonymity is a skill like any other. You're still learning it.

Ebonhall Academy.label: Academy Student
Ebonhall Academy.description: You're midway through your third year. Your marks are average except in Conixia theory, where they're suspiciously high given you've never attended that lecture.
Ebonhall Academy.backstory: You came to Ebonhall to learn. What you've discovered here wasn't in any syllabus.

Ebonhall Academy.label: Junior Faculty
Ebonhall Academy.description: You teach Introduction to Arcane History to students who mostly don't want to be there. A recent theft from the restricted archive has everyone on edge.
Ebonhall Academy.backstory: Teaching is how you stay close to the books that matter.

Ebonhall Academy.label: Academy Security
Ebonhall Academy.description: You guard the east wing — mostly from students who shouldn't be there after hours. Mostly.
Ebonhall Academy.backstory: The Academy's secrets are above your clearance. You've started to suspect your clearance is lower than you were told.

Nocturn Cove.label: Independent Smuggler
Nocturn Cove.description: The Cove is neutral ground and you've used it as a base for three years. Business is brisk, the harbormaster is paid, and someone just put a price on your cargo.
Nocturn Cove.backstory: Taxes are just piracy with better paperwork. You've made your peace with operating outside them.

Nocturn Cove.label: Ship's Crew
Nocturn Cove.description: Your vessel is docked for repairs after a rough run south. You've got coin, shore leave, and an overheard conversation you can't quite shake.
Nocturn Cove.backstory: You've seen most of the coast. The Cove is where you always end up between voyages.

Nocturn Cove.label: Information Broker
Nocturn Cove.description: Nocturn Cove is where secrets come to be sold. You're the one who sets the price. A new buyer has been asking for something they really shouldn't want.
Nocturn Cove.backstory: Everyone knows something worth knowing. Your talent is finding out what that is.

Duskmire Ruins.label: Shadow Warden
Duskmire Ruins.description: Your order keeps watch over what sleeps in the Duskmire. Something has started waking up. You haven't reported it yet — you're not sure who you trust.
Duskmire Ruins.backstory: The Wardens have kept this vigil for three generations. You've always wondered what you're actually guarding against.

Duskmire Ruins.label: Relic Seeker
Duskmire Ruins.description: Pre-Collapse artefacts fetch extraordinary prices from the right buyers. The Duskmire Ruins are the best hunting ground left — and the most dangerous.
Duskmire Ruins.backstory: The dead left things behind. You've made a living returning them to the living.

Duskmire Ruins.label: Exiled from the Order
Duskmire Ruins.description: You were removed from the Silent Watchers for reasons that were explained very briefly and are not up for discussion. The ruins are the only place your name means nothing.
Duskmire Ruins.backstory: Whatever you did or didn't do, the Order closed a door. You're still looking for the window.

Ashveil Keep.label: Shadow Agent
Ashveil Keep.description: The Silent Watchers placed you here years ago to monitor Ironclad Dominion activity. You've gone so deep you sometimes forget which side briefed you first.
Ashveil Keep.backstory: A good spy remembers their loyalties. You have several. That's the problem.

Ashveil Keep.label: Dominion Retainer
Ashveil Keep.description: The Keep employs your skills for 'discreet work.' The coin is exceptional. The things you've been asked to discreetly do are keeping you up at night.
Ashveil Keep.backstory: You told yourself you'd draw a line somewhere. You're still looking for where it is.

Ashveil Keep.label: Reluctant Guest
Ashveil Keep.description: You're not quite a prisoner. You're also not free to leave. The Dominion calls it 'protective custody.' You call it something else.
Ashveil Keep.backstory: They don't know what you can do in the dark. You've been deciding whether to show them.

Hollow Glen.label: Spirit Speaker
Hollow Glen.description: The Glen's echo speaks more loudly than usual. You've come to listen, as your bloodline has always done. What you're hearing isn't the ancestors.
Hollow Glen.backstory: Some Velari hear the shadows. Your family line hears what's beneath them.

Hollow Glen.label: Shadow Hunter
Hollow Glen.description: The Glen is your territory. You know every shadow path, every silent crossing. Something has been disturbing the patterns for three nights running.
Hollow Glen.backstory: You've hunted the Glen since before you could name the stars. Something new has arrived.

Hollow Glen.label: Fugitive
Hollow Glen.description: The Glen hides you well. You've been here six weeks. The Ironclad Dominion's trackers are patient, but the shadows here are older than their maps.
Hollow Glen.backstory: You saw something you weren't supposed to see. Now you're somewhere you weren't supposed to go.

Blackmoor Spires.label: Spire Keeper
Blackmoor Spires.description: The Blackmoor Spires are ancient Velari signal towers, long thought dead. One of them lit up three nights ago. You're the only Watcher close enough to have seen it.
Blackmoor Spires.backstory: The Spires were built to call for help across great distances. Something is calling.

Blackmoor Spires.label: Void Researcher
Blackmoor Spires.description: The corruption seeping into the Blackmoor has properties unlike natural shadow. You've been documenting it. Your notes have started disappearing between entries.
Blackmoor Spires.backstory: You came to study the dark. The dark has started studying you back.

Blackmoor Spires.label: Pilgrim
Blackmoor Spires.description: The Spires are a place of ancestral silence for the Velari — a place to hear your bloodline's oldest memories. Yours have been louder than usual since you arrived.
Blackmoor Spires.backstory: Your ancestors have been trying to tell you something for weeks. You're finally close enough to listen.

Cinderheart Forge.label: Master Smith
Cinderheart Forge.description: Your work is spoken of three provinces over. A new commission arrived yesterday with specifications that are impossible by any technique you know. You agreed to attempt it anyway.
Cinderheart Forge.backstory: Fire teaches patience. You've been its student for twenty years.

Cinderheart Forge.label: Forge Apprentice
Cinderheart Forge.description: You're on your second year under a master who demonstrates rather than explains. Last night's demonstration involved something that shouldn't be possible with ordinary flame.
Cinderheart Forge.backstory: You chose the forge because you wanted to make things that last. Now you wonder what else it might be able to make.

Cinderheart Forge.label: Weapons Inspector
Cinderheart Forge.description: The Merchant Guild audits Cinderheart's output quarterly. Your last three reports were accurate. Something in this quarter's numbers doesn't add up — and the discrepancy is enormous.
Cinderheart Forge.backstory: Numbers always tell a story. You've gotten very good at reading them.

Blazefall Bastion.label: Bastion Defender
Blazefall Bastion.description: Blazefall guards the only pass through the Molten Ranges. You've held this posting for four years. The tremors started two weeks ago. The kind that come from below, not above.
Blazefall Bastion.backstory: You guard the pass because someone has to. You stay because you're the best at it.

Blazefall Bastion.label: Exiled Warrior
Blazefall Bastion.description: You were stripped of your forge-name for a duel that went further than intended. Blazefall takes soldiers without asking for histories. It suits you both.
Blazefall Bastion.backstory: You didn't regret it then. You've had four years to start reconsidering.

Blazefall Bastion.label: Flame Pilgrim
Blazefall Bastion.description: The Ignari mark their coming-of-age by walking to the deepest fire they can find and returning. You found something at the Bastion's core that you were not meant to see.
Blazefall Bastion.backstory: The fire spoke to you. You're still working out what it said.

Moltrid Expanse.label: Lava Diver
Moltrid Expanse.description: Your clan harvests raw conixia-fused ore from beneath the Moltrid's cooling crust. The veins have shifted. The safest routes are now the most dangerous ones.
Moltrid Expanse.backstory: Most races consider your work suicidal. You consider theirs timid.

Moltrid Expanse.label: Expanse Cartographer
Moltrid Expanse.description: You map the Moltrid's ever-changing terrain for the Merchant Guild. Every month the map is wrong. This month it's wrong in a way that suggests someone — or something — rerouted the flows deliberately.
Moltrid Expanse.backstory: The land shouldn't change this fast. And yet here's the evidence.

Moltrid Expanse.label: Clan Outcast
Moltrid Expanse.description: You were cast out for refusing a forge-oath. The Expanse accepts those the clans discard. It doesn't forgive them. You're still deciding whether you want to be forgiven.
Moltrid Expanse.backstory: The forge-oath would have made you powerful. It would also have made you something you couldn't live with.

Ashen Plateau.label: Relic Guardian
Ashen Plateau.description: The Ashen Plateau is a graveyard of pre-Collapse Ignari war-forges. Your bloodline has guarded them for generations. Grave robbers have started coming better-equipped.
Ashen Plateau.backstory: What your ancestors built here was never meant to be found again. Someone has found the maps.

Ashen Plateau.label: Hermit Smith
Ashen Plateau.description: You withdrew to the Plateau to work without interruption. Three years of solitude have produced work that shouldn't be possible with known techniques. Visitors have started arriving to ask how.
Ashen Plateau.backstory: You needed quiet to hear the fire clearly. You've been hearing things no one else can explain.

Ashen Plateau.label: Ruins Scholar
Ashen Plateau.description: The war-forges of the Plateau contain metallurgical techniques lost to every modern tradition. You've been here six months deciphering them. Some of them should not be rediscovered.
Ashen Plateau.backstory: Knowledge has no moral position. The people who use it do. You're hoping the right people find these ruins first.

Celestwatch Observatory.label: Star Cartographer
Celestwatch Observatory.description: You map stellar movement and Conixia flux patterns. Three nights ago, a constellation shifted. That is not supposed to be possible — and it happened again last night.
Celestwatch Observatory.backstory: The stars are a language. You've spent a lifetime learning its grammar.

Celestwatch Observatory.label: AIM Seconded Observer
Celestwatch Observatory.description: AIM assigned you to the Observatory six months ago to monitor Conixia activity in the upper atmosphere. Your reports go somewhere. You've never met who reads them.
Celestwatch Observatory.backstory: The assignment sounded academic. The equipment they gave you suggests otherwise.

Celestwatch Observatory.label: Wandering Initiate
Celestwatch Observatory.description: Your order sent you here to 'complete your understanding.' They didn't specify of what. The Observatory's director has been avoiding you since you arrived.
Celestwatch Observatory.backstory: You came seeking answers. The Observatory seems to have a surplus of questions.

Timebent Library.label: Temporal Archivist
Timebent Library.description: The Timebent Library stores texts that are written before they occur. Your job is cataloguing the ones that have come true. The backlog is growing faster than it should.
Timebent Library.backstory: Most archivists dread the backlog. Yours means something is accelerating.

Timebent Library.label: Dream Cartographer
Timebent Library.description: Aetherin with the Dream Walker perk are sometimes hired to map locations visited in prophetic sleep — places that don't yet exist. One of your recent maps showed somewhere that now does.
Timebent Library.backstory: You map dreams for a living. One of them turned out to be a warning.

Timebent Library.label: Fugitive Scholar
Timebent Library.description: You took something from the Library's sealed section. You had excellent reasons. The Library's wardens have been following you for two weeks and you're running out of city.
Timebent Library.backstory: The sealed section exists to protect people from certain knowledge. You decided to be the one who knows.

Cradle of Whispers.label: Whisper Listener
Cradle of Whispers.description: The Cradle is a place where Aetherin go to hear voices from timelines that didn't survive. You've been here three weeks. The voices are starting to respond when you answer them.
Cradle of Whispers.backstory: They said you'd only be able to listen. They didn't say anything about the voices being able to hear you too.

Cradle of Whispers.label: Cradle Guardian
Cradle of Whispers.description: You maintain the wards that keep the Cradle's echoes from bleeding into waking memory. One of the wards failed last month. You patched it. Something came through before you did.
Cradle of Whispers.backstory: The wards were built to contain possibility. You've been doing the job for twelve years. This is the first time one has failed.

Cradle of Whispers.label: Unstuck in Time
Cradle of Whispers.description: You visited the Cradle two years ago. You arrived back yesterday. Everyone else thinks it was a week. You have extensive notes on why this matters and no one is listening.
Cradle of Whispers.backstory: Two years passed for you. A week passed for everyone else. The timeline considers both true.

Echo Vale.label: Echo Shepherd
Echo Vale.description: The Vale reflects sounds from the past — sometimes warnings. You've been trained since childhood to interpret them. A new echo arrived this morning that predates the Vale itself.
Echo Vale.backstory: The Vale remembers everything. It's starting to remember things that haven't happened yet.

Echo Vale.label: Astral Exile
Echo Vale.description: You were removed from your order after an Astral Flow meditation went wrong and you pulled three people into your dream against their will. The Vale is quiet enough that it doesn't happen again. Usually.
Echo Vale.backstory: They weren't hurt. They also weren't invited. The Order was very clear about the difference.

Echo Vale.label: Echo Researcher
Echo Vale.description: The echoes of the Vale have been studied for centuries. You're here to document a new phenomenon: silence. In a Vale that never stops echoing, the silences have been getting longer.
Echo Vale.backstory: What the Vale doesn't say is as important as what it does. Right now it's not saying a great deal.

Stonewake Graves.label: Grave Tender
Stonewake Graves.description: You maintain the resonance anchors that keep the sleeping Pillarians stable. One of the anchors has gone quiet. The body it was attached to has not.
Stonewake Graves.backstory: The waking and the sleeping are not so different. You stand between them.

Stonewake Graves.label: Newly Awakened
Stonewake Graves.description: You came online seventeen days ago. Your memories are from a century past. Everything you knew is renamed, repurposed, or gone. You're still deciding how to feel about that.
Stonewake Graves.backstory: Awakening is supposed to be a blessing. Nobody mentioned the grief that comes with it.

Stonewake Graves.label: Earth Collective Scholar
Stonewake Graves.description: You study Pillarian awakening cycles and the gravitics that sustain dormant forms. A recent awakening produced an anomaly your models can't explain — the subject awoke with memories that weren't theirs.
Stonewake Graves.backstory: Every anomaly is an invitation. You've never been able to decline one.

Echo Pillar Nexus.label: Nexus Resonant
Echo Pillar Nexus.description: The Pillars of the Nexus are the oldest gravitational anchors in Avalon. They hum at a frequency only Pillarians can feel. That hum has changed pitch, and no one from the Collective will tell you why.
Echo Pillar Nexus.backstory: You've felt the Pillars your whole life. They are as reliable as gravity. Until now.

Echo Pillar Nexus.label: Earth Collective Emissary
Echo Pillar Nexus.description: Three other factions have sent representatives to study the Nexus anomaly. You're here to ensure the Collective's interests are represented — and to make sure no one takes anything home with them.
Echo Pillar Nexus.backstory: Diplomacy is gravity by other means. You hold things in orbit; you don't let them collide.

Echo Pillar Nexus.label: Pillar Guardian
Echo Pillar Nexus.description: The Collective assigned you to guard the Nexus from outside interference. What they didn't tell you is what to do if the interference comes from inside the Pillars themselves.
Echo Pillar Nexus.backstory: Your orders were clear. Your orders did not account for this.

Dustborn Shrine.label: Shrine Keeper
Dustborn Shrine.description: The Dustborn Shrine honours Pillarians who chose to release their gravitational bond and scatter. You tend it. Recently, the dust has been reassembling itself into shapes.
Dustborn Shrine.backstory: The Released are supposed to be at rest. Someone forgot to tell the dust.

Dustborn Shrine.label: Dispersal Scholar
Dustborn Shrine.description: You study voluntary dispersal — the rare Pillarian practice of choosing to exist as distributed gravitational mass rather than bound form. Your latest subject reassembled six weeks after dispersal. Voluntarily.
Dustborn Shrine.backstory: Dispersal is considered final. Your data suggests otherwise.

Dustborn Shrine.label: Grief Pilgrim
Dustborn Shrine.description: You came to the Shrine to scatter a fragment of someone who dispersed before you were ready to let them go. The Shrine accepted the fragment. It's been giving it back in pieces ever since.
Dustborn Shrine.backstory: You came here to say goodbye. The Shrine appears to disagree with your timeline.

Fragmented Quarry.label: Gravitic Quarry Worker
Fragmented Quarry.description: The Quarry extracts gravitically-charged stone that only Pillarians can safely handle. The new vein opened last month contains ore that moves on its own when no one is watching.
Fragmented Quarry.backstory: You've worked stone your whole life. This stone has started working back.

Fragmented Quarry.label: Site Overseer
Fragmented Quarry.description: You manage extraction schedules and worker safety. Three workers have reported the same dream in the past week — of a Pillar deep below the Quarry that has never been mapped.
Fragmented Quarry.backstory: Dreams are not a safety incident. You're documenting them anyway.

Fragmented Quarry.label: Labour Exile
Fragmented Quarry.description: The Collective sent you here as a consequence for an unspecified infraction. The work is hard, the hours are worse, and you've found something in the deep cut that the Collective has very intentionally never mentioned.
Fragmented Quarry.backstory: They sent you to the worst posting they had. They forgot you'd still be looking.

Silvergrove Canopy.label: Grove Keeper
Silvergrove Canopy.description: The Silvergrove is your charge — its wards, its old agreements, its many grudges. A human expedition has requested access. The ward-trees are undecided.
Silvergrove Canopy.backstory: The grove doesn't speak in words. Twenty years taught you to listen another way.

Silvergrove Canopy.label: Arcane Diplomat
Silvergrove Canopy.description: You negotiate between the Canopy's council and the outside world. Three factions want something from the grove this season. Each has told you a different story about why.
Silvergrove Canopy.backstory: Every negotiation is really about something other than what's being negotiated.

Silvergrove Canopy.label: Weave Tender
Silvergrove Canopy.description: You maintain and extend the grove's magical infrastructure — the invisible lattice that keeps it alive. A weave-line you've kept stable for eight years has begun to fray from the inside.
Silvergrove Canopy.backstory: Magic is a living thing. Yours has been trying to tell you something.

Elarith Glade.label: Glade Chronicler
Elarith Glade.description: The Elarin record their history in living wood — each tree a chapter. You're the Glade's current scribe. Last month's entry began writing itself.
Elarith Glade.backstory: The trees have always been reliable narrators. This is the first time one has had an agenda.

Elarith Glade.label: Weaving Instructor
Elarith Glade.description: The Glade is an Elarin training ground for Arcane Weaving. Your youngest student performed a technique last week that takes most Elarin a decade to learn. She says she learned it from someone else. There is no one else.
Elarith Glade.backstory: You've been teaching for thirty years. You've never seen talent like this — and never seen anything that looked quite like fear with it.

Elarith Glade.label: Weave-Severed
Elarith Glade.description: Your connection to the Arcane Weave was severed as a punishment — you can't feel magic the way other Elarin can. The Glade tolerates you. The trees don't seem to know you're supposed to be cut off.
Elarith Glade.backstory: They severed the connection. They didn't account for it growing back differently.

The Hollowed Spire.label: Spire Warden
The Hollowed Spire.description: The Hollowed Spire is the oldest Elarin arcane structure still standing — and still active, despite being abandoned for three centuries. You've been assigned to find out why it reactivated.
The Hollowed Spire.backstory: Dead things don't reactivate. This one apparently didn't get the message.

The Hollowed Spire.label: Squatter
The Hollowed Spire.description: You've been living in the Spire's lower levels for two years — the magic keeps it warm and most people stay well away. Something in the upper levels started moving last week.
The Hollowed Spire.backstory: It was quiet and it was free. Two very compelling arguments. Still holding, mostly.

The Hollowed Spire.label: Arcane Archaeologist
The Hollowed Spire.description: The Spire predates the Elarin's own written records. You've been excavating the lower chambers to understand how it was built. Some of your findings suggest it wasn't built by Elarin at all.
The Hollowed Spire.backstory: Your people didn't make this. Someone made it for your people. That distinction matters enormously.

Echofen Reach.label: Reach Wanderer
Echofen Reach.description: The Echofen is where Elarin go when they need to think without their Weave sense interfering — the magic here is so dense it crowds out individual perception. You've been wandering it for months.
Echofen Reach.backstory: Too much clarity can be blinding. The Reach is where you come to think with the static turned up.

Echofen Reach.label: Arcane Ranger
Echofen Reach.description: You patrol the outer edge of the Echofen to keep non-Elarin from wandering in and losing themselves. Someone has been leaving markers inside the Reach — from the inside out.
Echofen Reach.backstory: The Reach disorients outsiders. Whatever left those markers wasn't disoriented.

Echofen Reach.label: Weave Hermit
Echofen Reach.description: You withdrew to the Echofen a decade ago to pursue arcane research in solitude. Your findings have been extraordinary. A visitor arrived two days ago claiming to be from your old order — an order that dissolved eight years after you left.
Echofen Reach.backstory: You left to be alone with your work. Your past has apparently found better directions.

Skarrback Hills.label: Clan Guardian
Skarrback Hills.description: You protect the Skarrback settlements from the things that come down from the ridge at night. This week the things are bigger — and they're coming before dark.
Skarrback Hills.backstory: The clan measures respect in scars. You've earned your standing the direct way.

Skarrback Hills.label: Clan Mediator
Skarrback Hills.description: Your Emotion Sense makes you the clan's first choice for disputes — you know when someone's lying before they finish the sentence. Two clans are three days from open war. You're the only one both sides will talk to.
Skarrback Hills.backstory: The strongest thing in the room is usually the one who keeps it from breaking.

Skarrback Hills.label: Outcast
Skarrback Hills.description: You were too quiet, too careful, too unlike what the clan expected. You've made a life on the edges of the Hills. Smaller in some ways. Freer in others.
Skarrback Hills.backstory: The clan called it weakness. You call it a different kind of strength.

Cragjaw Basin.label: Basin Trader
Cragjaw Basin.description: Cragjaw is a crossroads — Ogrin, Human, and Ignari all pass through. You trade in goods and emotions in equal measure. Someone is deliberately seeding anger through the market.
Cragjaw Basin.backstory: You can feel what a crowd wants before they know it themselves. Right now this crowd wants to hurt someone.

Cragjaw Basin.label: Empathic Healer
Cragjaw Basin.description: Ogrin Emotion Sense extends, with training, into physical pain. You heal by feeling what hurts. A patient arrived three days ago whose pain you can't locate — it doesn't seem to come from their body.
Cragjaw Basin.backstory: Pain always has a source. This patient's source is somewhere you haven't looked before.

Cragjaw Basin.label: Dominion Conscript
Cragjaw Basin.description: The Ironclad Dominion 'recruited' you. You've been stationed at the Cragjaw outpost for eight months. You haven't decided if you're a soldier or a hostage — and neither have your commanding officers.
Cragjaw Basin.backstory: The Dominion wanted Ogrin muscle. They got you, which is considerably more complicated than they expected.

Rubblehaven.label: Builder
Rubblehaven.description: Rubblehaven is a city built from the wreckage of four others. You build — with stone, with agreements, with the careful management of people who've lost too much. Something is destabilising the foundations from below.
Rubblehaven.backstory: You build because things fall down. Someone or something is trying to prove your point.

Rubblehaven.label: Peacekeeper
Rubblehaven.description: Rubblehaven's mix of displaced peoples makes it volatile. You keep the peace through presence, empathy, and the occasional demonstration that you can lift a cart. One faction has recently started feeling afraid — all of them, all at once.
Rubblehaven.backstory: Fear is contagious. You need to find the source before it spreads.

Rubblehaven.label: Displaced
Rubblehaven.description: Your clan settlement was destroyed — not by enemies, but by something stranger. You brought your people here. Rubblehaven took you in. You're still trying to understand what you ran from.
Rubblehaven.backstory: You know what battle damage looks like. What happened to your clan's settlement was not that.

The Broken Teeth.label: Ridge Hermit
The Broken Teeth.description: The Broken Teeth is a series of shattered peaks that Ogrin rarely visit — too dangerous, too remote. You went there to get away from feeling everyone else's emotions. The rocks don't have any. It was peaceful until they started.
The Broken Teeth.backstory: You needed silence. The Broken Teeth are as close to silence as your gift allows. Something here has started to feel.

The Broken Teeth.label: Ancient Site Guardian
The Broken Teeth.description: Your bloodline has guarded an unnamed structure in the Broken Teeth for generations. The instructions passed down with the duty are clear. They don't cover what to do when the structure opens from the inside.
The Broken Teeth.backstory: Four generations of your family have guarded something they were told never to enter. You're reconsidering the terms.

The Broken Teeth.label: Exile of All Clans
The Broken Teeth.description: You were banished — not by one clan but by a council of three simultaneously. The charge was 'emotional manipulation,' which is an ironic thing to accuse someone whose power only works passively. You've been here long enough to stop being angry about it.
The Broken Teeth.backstory: Three clans acting together is unprecedented. You've had a lot of time to wonder what you did that scared them that much.

Fennmire Swamps.label: Swamp Guide
Fennmire Swamps.description: You know every safe path through the Fennmire. A recent client disappeared on a route you know to be safe. The route has changed — not the terrain, the ecosystem. Something rerouted the living parts.
Fennmire Swamps.backstory: The swamp shifts. You shift with it. Something has shifted that shouldn't have.

Fennmire Swamps.label: Unsanctioned Observer
Fennmire Swamps.description: Someone has been using the Fennmire's deepest channels for meetings. You've been watching for two weeks. You don't know who hired you — the coin was left without a note and the amount suggested you shouldn't ask.
Fennmire Swamps.backstory: Information without a client is just curiosity. You've always been curious by nature.

Fennmire Swamps.label: Biotic Healer
Fennmire Swamps.description: Your regenerative Conixia extends to others with training. People come to the Fennmire specifically for you. A patient arrived last week with wounds that aren't healing — and your regeneration actively reverses near them.
Fennmire Swamps.backstory: You mend what the world breaks. You've never met something that actively resisted mending.

Trollspire Ruins.label: Ancestral Guardian
Trollspire Ruins.description: The Trollspire Ruins are what remains of the Trollan's last great city, destroyed in the Collapse. Your clan has protected them from looters for generations. A new kind of intruder has arrived: archaeologists with credentials that look official but aren't.
Trollspire Ruins.backstory: Looters want treasure. These visitors want something else. You intend to find out what.

Trollspire Ruins.label: Ruin Excavator
Trollspire Ruins.description: You excavate the Trollspire Ruins to understand pre-Collapse Trollan civilization — specifically the Biotic Resonance techniques that were lost. One of the chambers you've opened has been occupied. Recently.
Trollspire Ruins.backstory: History is supposed to stay in the past. Someone in these ruins appears to be present tense.

Trollspire Ruins.label: Exiled to the Ruins
Trollspire Ruins.description: Exile among Trollan isn't imprisonment — it's assignment to the places no one else will go. The Trollspire Ruins are the worst posting available. You've been here three months and found enough to justify everything you did to get sent here.
Trollspire Ruins.backstory: They sent you here as a punishment. The ruins are starting to feel like a reward.

Mossgrit Depths.label: Depth Harvester
Mossgrit Depths.description: The Mossgrit Depths produce bioactive compounds used in Trollan regeneration treatments. The last three harvests have come back wrong — the compounds accelerate regrowth past the point of recognition.
Mossgrit Depths.backstory: You've worked these depths your whole life. The Depths have been working back lately.

Mossgrit Depths.label: Depths Hermit
Mossgrit Depths.description: You withdrew to the Mossgrit when your regeneration stopped being able to tell the difference between healing and changing. The Depths are the only place it's quiet enough to maintain control.
Mossgrit Depths.backstory: Regeneration is supposed to restore what was. Yours has started to have opinions about what should be.

Mossgrit Depths.label: Biotic Researcher
Mossgrit Depths.description: You study the Mossgrit's unique ecosystem to understand the root mechanism of Trollan Biotic Resonance. Your most recent discovery suggests the Depths are not a natural formation — they were cultivated, deliberately, long before the Trollan arrived.
Mossgrit Depths.backstory: The Depths were made for someone. Evidence suggests they were made for you, specifically. Or your kind.

Bogshadow Border.label: Bogshadow Warden
Bogshadow Border.description: The Border is where the Fennmire's living ecosystem ends and the Void corruption begins. You walk the line daily. The line has been moving inward for the past month — six inches a day, exactly.
Bogshadow Border.backstory: The corruption doesn't rush. It's patient in a way that feels intentional.

Bogshadow Border.label: Border Trader
Bogshadow Border.description: The Bogshadow Border is a place where people who don't want to be tracked make exchanges. You facilitate this. Your latest regular client stopped coming three weeks ago. Their last trade was information about a Void incursion. You sold it to the wrong person.
Bogshadow Border.backstory: In this business you learn not to ask what things are for. This is the first time that policy has felt like a mistake.

Bogshadow Border.label: Void-Touched Exile
Bogshadow Border.description: You got too close to a Void incursion and something changed in how your regeneration works. Your clan sent you to the Border — close enough to study, far enough to be safe. The irony is not lost on you.
Bogshadow Border.backstory: You regenerate differently now. Faster, stranger, wrong in ways that are hard to articulate. The Border is where the answer to that might live.
